title: Quarterly roadmap: predictive-slices and tiered SLO bands for Dedicated autoscale
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Goal: Deliver a quarterly plan and first-phase implementation to reduce tail latency and avoid overprovisioning by combining predictive capacity slices with tiered SLO bands. This ticket scopes the PM roadmap, cross-team milestones, success metrics, and a conservative rollout plan.

Context:
- We continue to see cost leakage driven by reactive autoscaling during spiky traffic and prewarm gaps across dedicated pools.
- Previous experiments improved median latency but left 95/99th percentile spikes unaddressed for less predictable tenants.

What success looks like this quarter:
- Productize a predictive slice scheduler (simulation sandbox + baseline model) that can propose warm-up windows per slice.
- Define and ship tiered SLO bands (Gold/Silver/Bronze) and default routing policies for Dedicated customers.
- Run two canary pilots with internal customers: one latency-sensitive (Gold) and one cost-sensitive (Bronze).
- Reduce 99th percentile latency for canary tenants by at least 20% and reduce committed GPU-hours waste by 10% in pilot pools.

Scope (this ticket):
- Roadmap doc + OKR mapping, milestone dates, and stakeholder RACI.
- Definition of SLO bands and default autoscale guardrails.
- Simulation suite spec and acceptance criteria for the predictive scheduler.
- Pilot orchestration plan with monitoring playbook and rollback criteria.
- Dependency map and required engineering tickets for implementation.

Out of scope for this quarter:
- Full platform rollout across all customers.
- Pricing/contract changes for reserved capacity (these follow after pilot validation).
okrs:
Q2 OKR alignment:
- OKR 1 (Resilience): Reduce tail latency for Dedicated pools by 25% in pilot groups.
- OKR 2 (Economics): Reduce idle GPU-hours in pilot pools by 10%.
- OKR 3 (Adoption): Convert at least 2 pilot customers to early access for tiered SLOs.

metrics: Successful canary requests served from warm cache: target >= 70%
False positive scaling events per 24h: target < 2 for Gold
rollout_phases: Phase 0 - Design & Simulation: run sim across 4 weeks to validate warm-window model
Phase 1 - Internal Canary: enable on 2 internal tenants with conservative thresholds
Phase 2 - Customer Pilot: invite 2 external customers, monitor cost/latency and support playbook
Phase 3 - Gradual Rollout: widen to 20% of pools with automated rollback and telemetry gating
risks: Predictive model overfits to historical patterns and misses new traffic modes
Warm-up operations increase transient load, causing brief SLO degradations
Edge cases for multi-tenant pools where one slice's prewarm hurts another
Telemetry gaps could mask regressions in tail latency during pilot
decisions: Adopt slice-level predictive warm-up vs global prewarm for first pilot (conservative)
Default include three SLO bands: Gold (latency-first), Silver (balanced), Bronze (cost-first)
Require explicit customer opt-in for Bronze band in pilot to measure cost delta
